newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Oct tax revenue 12.5 pct up on year ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Oct tax revenue 12.5 pct up on year ago.

text.p: Argentina's tax revenue in October reached $3.72 billion, a 12.5 percent increase over October 1995 and 12.9 percent more than in September, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
Including contributions from private pension funds, total fiscal revenue was $3.97 billion, up 13.5 percent from the same month last year and 12.3 percent more than in September.

Revenues from income tax were $522.4 million, 14.0 percent more than in October 1995 and 7.9 percent more than in September. Income from value-added-tax was $1.61 billion, 11.6 percent more than in the same month last year and also 11.6 percent more than in September.
Customs revenue was $864.5 million, 28.7 percent more than in October and 16.0 percent more than in September.
